statement: Pinned OpenPuck Switch Pro emulation constructs a common input prefix with battery, three button bytes, two three-byte packed sticks and IMU samples; full 0x30 streaming is gated on a received report-mode 0x03/0x30 subcommand.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Device-side compatibility model, not physical packet-cadence or calibration validation. OpenPuck translates a distinct source controller's axes.
